thread:
olivia: Heads up — after the routing-weight normalization rollout (~10:15 UTC) we see a ~4x spike in streaming.reconnect.count for a subset of EU tenants. Console per-route counts also show a weird dip for those tenants, as if the route tag vanished :eyes:
raj: seeing the same. digging through proxy logs now. quick log sample — notice resume_id is `-` for a bunch of sessions: 
```
2026-03-22T10:17:03Z proxy=gw-7 route=opaque auth_tenant=acct-42 resume_id=- streaming.reconnect reason=client-closed
2026-03-22T10:17:04Z proxy=gw-7 route=opaque auth_tenant=acct-42 resume_id=- streaming.resume.latency=312ms
```
marta: that looks like the serializer change in the telemetry sampler PR we merged yesterday (PR #342). it strips unknown tags by default unless whitelisted. @ben did the canary include the new sampler?
ben: yeah, I shipped the sampler tweak in canary to reduce cardinality. thought it was safe — apparently it dropped `route_hint` and `resume_id` for SSE/ws event envelopes. reverting now. :grimacing:
kevin: dropping `route_hint` explains billing attribution weirdness — the quota pipeline falls back to the default bucket and that makes it look like random tenants spiked. not real request duplication, just misattribution.
raj: quick mitigation options: 1) revert sampler (ben) — immediate 2) add aggregator fallback to infer route from `auth_tenant`+`client_ip` for missing tags — medium term 3) temporarily reduce console sample rate for streaming.reconnects to cut noise — low effort.
marta: also recommend emitting a boolean metric `streaming.resume_id_present` (0/1) so we can alert when serializer drops fields. we currently only count reconnects which hides the root cause.
olivia: agreed. proposed action plan (today):
  - ben: revert sampler canary -> global rollback if canary already crossed threshold (ETA 20m)
  - raj: add aggregator-level fallback (inferred_route tag) + a safety test that ensures `route_key` is always present (ETA 2h)
  - marta: add `resume_id_present` metric and a short-lived alert (ETA 1h)
  - kevin: update dashboards to surface sample-rate and serializer-version and schedule a 5% canary for the new aggregator logic (ETA after raj's PR)
If any step slips, we rollback the routing-weight normalization to avoid customer impact.
ben: I rolled the revert and pushed a rollback commit: https://github.com/redwood/inference/commit/abc123 — canary rollback succeeded :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy event — ops/sampler reverted to v1.11 by ben at 2026-03-22T10:22:47Z — status: success
kevin: dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/streams/streaming-reconnects?panelId=7 — filter by `serializer_version` and look for the drop around 10:15. add `route_hint` column if available.
raj: small patch I will add to aggregator: if `route_key` missing then set `inferred_route:<tenant_hash>` and emit a log line `inferred_route=...` so we can confirm correctness before exposing to billing pipeline. will include unit test.
marta: alert rule draft: `sum(rate(streaming.resume_id_present[2m])) / sum(rate(streaming.reconnect.count[2m])) < 0.98` -> alert when < 98% for > 5m. posting PR shortly.
olivia: thanks. one UX note: console rollout UX should surface `serializer_version` and a per-route sample-rate at top of the Streaming dashboard. we burned time because the sample-rate change wasn't obvious. file a console ticket?
ben: filed CON-789 with screenshots. tagging you all. :white_check_mark:
kevin: quick reminder — any aggregator fallback we add must be opt-in for billing pipelines until we validate it for 24h with canary tenants. otherwise we risk silently changing customer invoices.
raj: agreed. fallback will be emitted to internal telemetry topic only and not read by billing until we flip a gate.
marta: tests and alert PRs up. will post links when green.
olivia: great. owners: ben (rollback done), raj (aggregator fallback PR), marta (metric + alert), kevin (dashboard + canary). target: EOD. ping here when each step is complete. :pray:
ben: done with rollback and verifying metric backfill now. I see per-route counts recovering in canary.
raj: opened PR https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/456 — includes tests and a feature flag.
marta: alert PR up: https://github.com/redwood/ops-alerts/pull/12 — running CI.
olivia: awesome. leaving this thread open until the canary is healthy for 1h. thanks everyone. :coffee:
